messages.text: I love the way it looks, I saw the AMA youtube video on it. It's well designed, offers good efficiency, and 3 hasrate options (although to be honest the 50TH/s mode isn't realistic or practical unless it's running in a very cold environment).  The 40T magic miner doesn't look out of place in my office room, and has great cost per TH. Harlo OS is the cherry on top. I come from AxeOS devices, so this will be my first Harlo OS device. Really looking forward to when mine arrives. Speaking of which, are you able to provide an estimate (ETA) for my batch 3 order?

Nice breakdown, and Harlo OS will feel familiar coming from AxeOS.

On your batch 3 unit, I can pull the exact date off the order. What's the order number, or the email it was placed with? Either one gets me there.
Sept 18 is the order date. ORDER Shop····

Got it, Paul. Your batch 3 Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, 2026, with the Power Kit going out in the same box.

Nothing has shipped yet, and the order is paid in full. Tracking goes to the email on the order as soon as it leaves the warehouse.
awesome. thanks for the help and practical advice. It's refreshing

Glad it helped, Paul.

One more thing while you're here: have you looked at anything besides the 40T, or is it the only one on your list?

I accumulated so many smaller miners that my fleet looks like a land of misfit toys. So that's what drew me to the 40T. I can see myself building out an entire fleet of these to replace my hodge podge of current units over time. I also love the fact that the 40T has the power supply built-into the unit itself. All of my miners have external PSUs of varying power, dimensions, and quality. So the 40T solves a lot of that for me.

That's the cleanest reason I've heard for it, and the integrated PSU is the part people underrate.

When you do start replacing the misfits, would you go all 40Ts, or mix in something bigger alongside them?

I read up on the 70T and it doesn't appear to hit the sweet spot that the 40T. Do I have that right? Or maybe my understanding of the 70T is incorrect. Can you give me a side-by-side comparison of the two?

You've got it about right, for your situation.

70T: $1,100, 70 TH/s, ~1.45 kW, 21 J/TH, external-style full-size box that needs its own 15A circuit. In MA at 22c that's roughly $233/month in power.

40T: $799, 40 TH/s, ~650W, 16 J/TH, built-in 94% PSU, 33cm desktop, ~50 dB in Eco.

The 70T is slightly cheaper per terahash, but it's a third less efficient, much louder, and it's a wiring project. For an office fleet the 40T wins on everything you told me matters.

One thing: the 70T is sold out right now, so it isn't orderable anyway.
